facts.claim: 52 C-5M Super Galaxies remain active, the US Air Force is the only operator, and the C-5M is the largest military transport aircraft built for the US Air Force and the third largest in the world after the now-destroyed Antonov An-225 and the An-124.

The Air Force's Fiscal Year 2027 budget request moves the fleet's retirement to FY2050, five years later than the previous plan, even though only about 37% of the jets were mission capable in FY2025, down from 49% the year before.

A total of 131 Lockheed C-5 Galaxies were produced: 81 C-5As and 50 C-5Bs, plus two C-5As modified to the C-5C standard; the 52 active aircraft are all upgraded to the C-5M standard, mostly modified C-5Bs.

Per the US Air Force, the C-5M has a maximum take-off weight of 840,000 pounds, a maximum payload of 281,001 pounds, and an unrefuelled range of 4,800 nautical miles with 120,000 pounds of cargo and 7,000 nautical miles with no cargo, powered by four General Electric F138-GE-100 engines of 51,250 pounds of thrust each.

The first C-5 was delivered in 1970; the Air Force received its first upgraded C-5M in 2008, with work concluding in 2018, and the C-5 has seen extensive use in every major global contingency since the Southeast Asia War.

Planespotters.net lists six C-5s as written off, 15 as scrapped with another partially scrapped, 37 stored mostly at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, and one preserved: airframe 69-0014 at the Air Mobility Command Museum at Dover Air Force Base.

The Air Force expects the first aircraft from its Next-Generation Airlift (NGAL) program around 2038, and each NGAL aircraft is set to replace one C-5M; production of the C-5 ended in 1989 and there is no discussion of restarting it.

zh.title: 美軍C-5大型運輸飛機僅剩52架 延役至2050年妥善率僅37%
zh.summary: 美國空軍僅剩52架C-5M超級銀河式運輸機，且妥善率跌至37%；儘管如此，2027財年預算案將其退役時程延後至2050年，較原計畫晚5年。
body: 洛克希德C-5M超級銀河式是美國空軍建造的最大軍用運輸機，也是全球第三大運輸機，僅次於已毀的安托諾夫An-225與An-124。現役僅剩52架，全數為升級後的C-5M，美國空軍是唯一使用單位。首架C-5於1970年交付，機隊曾參與越戰以來美國每場主要全球軍事行動。
全機隊共生產131架，包括81架C-5A與50架C-5B，另有2架C-5A改裝為C-5C以運載衛星等大型貨物；現役52架C-5M大多由C-5B升級而來。按美國空軍數據，C-5M最大起飛重量840000磅、最大酬載281001磅，載運120000磅貨物時不加油航程4800海里、空載時7000海里，配備4具通用電氣F138-GE-100發動機，單具推力51250磅。
妥善率下滑是延役的最大隱憂：2025財年僅約37%的機隊具備任務能力，低於前一年的49%。儘管如此，2027財年預算案仍將退役時程延至2050財年，較先前計畫晚5年。接替機種仍在遠方：下一代空運計畫NGAL首架飛機預計約2038年問世，每架將取代一架C-5M；C-5生產線已於1989年關閉，復產不在討論之列。
其餘機身去向分明：Planespotters.net統計，131架中有6架報廢、15架拆解另有1架部分拆解、37架封存（多在亞利桑那州戴維斯—蒙森空軍基地），另有1架保存展示——69-0014號機現於德拉瓦州多佛空軍基地的空中機動司令部博物館。計入封存與展示機，全世界現存C-5約90至110架，視封存數採37架或57架而定。

en.title: 52 Lockheed C-5M Galaxy aircraft remain in US service, flying until 2050
en.summary: The US Air Force has 52 C-5M Super Galaxies left, its largest military transport, and now plans to fly them until 2050 even as only about 37% of the fleet was mission capable in FY2025.
body: The Lockheed C-5M Super Galaxy is the largest military transport aircraft built for the United States Air Force and the third largest in the world, after the now-destroyed Antonov An-225 and the An-124. A total of 52 Super Galaxies remain active, with the rest in storage, scrapped, written off, or cannibalized for parts. The US Air Force is the only C-5M operator, and it now plans to keep the type flying until 2050. The first C-5 was delivered in 1970, and the Air Force says the type "has seen extensive use in every major global contingency since the Southeast Asia War".

Lockheed produced 131 Galaxies in total: 81 C-5As and 50 C-5Bs, plus two C-5As modified to the C-5C standard to carry outsized cargo such as satellites. The 52 active aircraft are all upgraded to the C-5M Super Galaxy standard, mostly modified C-5Bs. Per the US Air Force, the C-5M has a maximum take-off weight of 840,000 pounds, a maximum payload of 281,001 pounds, and an unrefuelled range of 4,800 nautical miles with 120,000 pounds of cargo — 7,000 nautical miles with no cargo — powered by four General Electric F138-GE-100 engines producing 51,250 pounds of thrust each.

The FY2027 budget request moves the fleet's retirement to FY2050, five years later than the previous plan, The War Zone reported. Readiness is the worry: about 37% of the jets were mission capable in FY2025, down from 49% the year before. The replacement is still more than a decade away — the Air Force expects the first aircraft from its Next-Generation Airlift (NGAL) program around 2038, according to Air & Space Forces Magazine, with each NGAL aircraft set to replace one C-5M. Production of the C-5 ended in 1989, and there is no discussion of restarting it.

Planespotters.net lists six C-5s as written off, 15 as scrapped with another partially scrapped, and 37 stored, mostly at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Arizona, while one is preserved — airframe 69-0014, on display at the Air Mobility Command Museum at Dover Air Force Base. Add the stored airframes and the preserved example to the 52 in service, and somewhere between 90 and 110 C-5s still exist, depending on whether the storage count is 37 or the 57 cited by AMARC Experience.
